boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe places for art, outdoor time, and local history with documented free admission or no entrance fee.

cards.title: Browse the Harnett Museum of Art
cards.subtitle: University of Richmond campus
cards.notes: Visit during posted museum hours and take time with the current exhibitions; check the museum site before heading over because seasonal closures occur.
cards.short_summary: A campus art-museum stop with always-free admission.
cards.evidence_claim: University Museums states that admission is always free and identifies the Harnett Museum as one of its museums.
cards.access_notes: Admission is always free; the museum site says to consult posted hours and notes seasonal closures.

cards.entity_name: Lora Robins Gallery of Design from Nature
cards.title: Explore the Lora Robins Gallery
cards.subtitle: Boatwright Library, University of Richmond campus
cards.notes: Pair a gallery visit with time in Boatwright Library, and consult the museum’s current-hours page before you go for reopening and exhibition details.
cards.short_summary: Free design, natural-history, and collection-focused gallery viewing on campus.
cards.evidence_claim: University Museums lists the Lora Robins Gallery and says admission is always free.
cards.access_notes: Located at Boatwright Library; admission is always free, subject to posted museum hours.

cards.entity_name: Joel and Lila Harnett Print Study Center
cards.title: See prints at the Harnett Print Study Center
cards.subtitle: University of Richmond campus
cards.notes: Use the museum’s collection and visitor information to plan a print-focused visit, then confirm the center’s current availability before leaving campus.
cards.short_summary: A free campus museum destination centered on works on paper.
cards.evidence_claim: The University identifies the Harnett Print Study Center as part of University Museums, whose admission is always free.
cards.source_title: University & Local Museums — University of Richmond Art & Art History
cards.access_notes: Admission to all University Museums is free and open to the public; confirm access details before visiting.

cards.title: Walk the paths at Westhampton Lake
cards.subtitle: University of Richmond campus
cards.notes: Start at the lake paths for a relaxed outdoor loop and observe wildlife from the shore; do not feed waterfowl or disturb the lake environment.
cards.short_summary: A ten-acre campus lake open to recreation and visitor exploration.
cards.evidence_claim: The University invites visitors to its campus for recreation and identifies Westhampton Lake as an explore destination; it also describes the lake as a recreational area for campus and visitors.
cards.source_title: Fishing at Westhampton Lake — University of Richmond Sustainability
cards.access_notes: Visit as outdoor campus recreation; fishing is separately governed by Virginia freshwater regulations and is not required for this hang.

cards.title: Take a nature walk in the Eco-Corridor
cards.subtitle: University of Richmond campus
cards.notes: Walk the renovated trail, look for native plantings and the restored creek, and stay on established paths while giving pollinator habitat space.
cards.short_summary: A campus-to-neighborhood nature corridor with walking and biking trail access.
cards.evidence_claim: The University describes the Gambles Mill Eco-Corridor as having a renovated walking and biking trail, native plantings, outdoor learning spaces, and restored Little Westham Creek.
cards.source_title: Spider Sustainability Self-Guided Tour — University of Richmond
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus destination; use the established walking and biking trail and follow site signage.

cards.title: Visit VMFA’s permanent collection
cards.subtitle: 200 N. Arthur Ashe Boulevard, Richmond
cards.notes: Plan a gallery wander around the permanent collection and check the museum calendar if you want to avoid ticketed special exhibitions.
cards.short_summary: A major Richmond art museum where general admission is always free.
cards.evidence_claim: VMFA states that admission is always free; the University of Richmond also identifies VMFA general admission as always free.
cards.source_title: University & Local Museums — University of Richmond Art & Art History
cards.access_notes: General admission is always free; special exhibitions or programs may have separate charges.

cards.title: Take a free Capitol tour
cards.subtitle: 1000 Bank Street, Richmond
cards.notes: Join a walk-in guided tour or use the self-guided option during operating hours; allow time for entry procedures and check closures before traveling.
cards.short_summary: A historic government-building visit with free guided and self-guided tours.
cards.evidence_claim: The Virginia Capitol brochure states that one-hour guided tours are free and self-guided tours are available during daily operating hours.
cards.access_notes: Free guided tours are offered daily at stated times; self-guided tours are available during operating hours, subject to closures and security procedures.

cards.entity_name: Maggie L. Walker National Historic Site
cards.title: Learn at the Maggie L. Walker site
cards.subtitle: 600 N. 2nd Street, Richmond
cards.notes: Visit the national historic site to learn about Maggie L. Walker and confirm current ranger-program or building-access details before setting out.
cards.short_summary: A free National Park Service historic-site visit in Richmond.
cards.evidence_claim: The National Park Service states that no entrance pass is required and there is no admission fee to visit Maggie L. Walker National Historic Site.
cards.source_title: Fees & Passes — Maggie L. Walker National Historic Site
cards.access_notes: No entrance pass or admission fee is required; verify current building and program availability with the site.

cards.title: Explore Chimborazo Medical Museum
cards.subtitle: Richmond National Battlefield Park, 3215 E. Broad Street
cards.notes: Use the visitor center as a history-focused stop and check the current operating schedule before you go, particularly for weekday or seasonal changes.
cards.short_summary: A Civil War medical-history museum within a no-entrance-fee national park.
cards.evidence_claim: The National Park Service says there are no entrance fees at any Richmond National Battlefield Park sites and identifies the Chimborazo Medical Museum Visitor Center.
cards.source_title: Fees & Passes — Richmond National Battlefield Park
cards.access_notes: No park entrance fee; the NPS page notes the Chimborazo Medical Museum Visitor Center schedule separately, so confirm hours before visiting.

cards.title: Walk Maymont’s grounds
cards.subtitle: 1700 Hampton Street, Richmond
cards.notes: Use the walking paths and landscaped gardens for an outdoor hang, and verify any separately ticketed indoor attraction or program before making plans.
cards.short_summary: A historic estate and public park with free admission for its grounds and paths.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit Richmond states that Maymont offers free admission to explore walking paths, landscaped gardens, farm animals, and the Virginia Wildlife Trail.
cards.access_notes: Free admission covers the stated outdoor exploration; some indoor attractions, programs, or parking arrangements can differ, so check Maymont before visiting.
